name: Ranath
bio: Ranath goes where others fear to tread. He leads expeditions into the Underroot, a living maze that runs deep beneath the Emerald Kingdom. To survive, he wields the Greenfire – a magic so dangerous that most Eldrin oppose its use. But Ranath has no time for their games. He has wars to win.
